reference.title: No reference: the request "a linen card under a desk lamp"; mechanism copied from bar 01-lamp-on-paper

beats: Evening: a linen card lies on the desk, and a desk lamp over its top-left corner throws a warm pool across it; the card's weave and cut edge catch the light, the desk beyond sinks into the dim room
The lamp turns to aim where the pointer is, staying on the card; the printed note reads inside the pool
